normalized.description:
Context:
The visual verification of vehicle badges at CSG does not provide a sufficiently high level of security for access control. An automated license plate check should be set up at access points.
Description:
When approaching the barrier, the system must automatically recognize a vehicle's license plate and check whether it is authorized to enter the site. Controls must be automatic and instantaneous, with no need for the security guard to intervene, thus ensuring greater fluidity and efficiency.
In conjunction with the digital access control system, which efficiently verifies the identity of those on board, access can be authorized and the access barrier lifted.

Metsäkeskukselle toimitetaan puustotulkintatiedot koko inventointialueelta kaikkien maanomistajien metsätalousmailta. normalized.description: RVO is responsible for publishing a site characterization package for end users to prepare bids for a permit tender to build and operate a wind farm. These works consist of the detailed design metocean assessment (MA) at two Wind Farm Zones (WFZs). One of the WFZs is IJmuiden Ver and the second WFZ is to be determined. The assessment includes the construction of a metocean database, and a metocean assessment (consisting of a metocean desk study and a wind resource assessment) on design level. The starting date of the contract is scheduled for Q2 2022. In Q4 2022, a first non public delivery is expected based upon existing data sources. In Q2 2023, a second delivery should contain around 6 months of measurement data from the planned floating LiDAR campaign in the Ijmuiden Ver WFZ (IJV WFZ). A third and fourth delivery will contain 1 year and 2 years of measurement data respectively. The fifth and sixth delivery will contain a comparable series for a second to be determined WFZ.
